reuse.why: Creates one shared policy module (shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory, getMonthBudgetCategories, averageToBudgetAmount) and routes all month-wide actions and setNMonthAvg through it, reusing getBudgetData and getSheetValue.

duplication.why: The four copied category queries and inline income/sign checks are removed; only the two near-identical SELECTs inside getMonthBudgetCategories remain, one of which is unused.

placement.why: A dedicated budget/month-action-categories.ts module beside actions.ts is a reasonable home for the policy; the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes stay on month-wide actions, but the diff adds a speculative copy-previous query branch and never implements the step-3 #fixed group exclusion.

maintainability.why: Exclusions now change in one predicate, but the helper carries an unused action parameter, a dead copy-previous branch with its previousMonth argument, and callers pass positional undefined, which will confuse future owners.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts loads rows with getBudgetData and calls the predicate directly instead of getMonthBudgetCategories('copy-previous', ...), leaving that branch of the helper unused.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthBudgetCategories/shouldIncludeMonthBudgetCategory take an action discriminator (unused by the predicate), previousMonth and includeHiddenCategories; the helper has a copy-previous query branch and an includeHiddenCategories branch; copyPreviousMonth bypasses the selector.
